items.name: tokens
items.title: UI Polish tokens
items.description: The --ui-* roles every UI Polish component reads, with UI Polish's own light and dark values, plus the Tailwind bridge (bg-ui-surface, text-ui-muted).

items.name: theme
items.title: UI Polish on your shadcn/ui theme
items.description: The tokens, the Tailwind bridge and a mapping that points the color and radius roles at your shadcn/ui variables, so the components follow your theme in light and dark.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Disclosure sections that open on a grid-row transition, one or several at a time. An item named in the URL hash is already open on first paint.

items.name: agent-settings
items.title: Agent settings
items.description: A whole settings screen for an AI agent, built from the kit: model, MCP connections, what it may do without asking, a daily spending limit and memory. Every change saves in its row, and a sticky section nav follows you down the page.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Inline banner for info, success, warning and error. It reserves its space up front or opens on a press, so a late status never pushes the page.

items.name: authorize
items.title: Authorize
items.description: The consent screen an MCP server shows when an agent asks to connect: who's asking, what it will be able to do, and where you go back to. Risky permissions start off.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Photo with initials on an opaque quiet fill behind it, or a head and shoulders with no name. A quick photo never flashes initials, a broken one never shows its broken mark, and groups overlap with a +N that says how many.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A static label for a status or a count, exactly as tall as the line it sits in. Counts are round for one digit and set in equal-width figures.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: Trail of links to the current page. A long middle folds into a … that opens in place, long labels fade instead of wrapping, and any router’s link fits.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Pill button that presses instantly and springs back. The busy state keeps its width, and the label morphs when its text changes.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Base UI checkbox whose tick draws on and off. The mixed-state dash morphs into the tick, and the box aligns to the first line of its label.

items.name: chip
items.title: Chip
items.description: Filter chips that stay pressed, and removable chips with their own named remove button. A plus swings into a check without changing the width, and removed chips fade before the rest slide into place.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code block for AI apps that streams in without flashing or jumping. Copy, line wrap and calm token-colored highlighting are built in, with no highlighter library.

items.name: code-input
items.title: Code input
items.description: One-time code boxes that fill from a paste or platform autofill and step back on Backspace. The active box shows a dark edge and a caret, invalid shows in the edges; an optional status folds the boxes into a centered, edgeless Verifying pill that turns to Verified, or opens back up on a wrong code.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Type-to-filter autocomplete for local or async results. Each match marks the typed text, and stale results stay in place while new ones load.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command palette
items.description: ⌘K palette with fuzzy matching, recents and grouped results. Async sources never flash a loading state, and the height follows the results.

items.name: connections
items.title: Connections
items.description: The agent app's list of MCP servers: one quiet row each, a switch, and a status line that says what's wrong and the one thing that fixes it. Adds a server by URL and hands sign-in to the browser.

items.name: copy-field
items.title: Copy field
items.description: Read-only value with a Copy button whose icon turns into a check and says “Copied” to screen readers. A secret masks as a fixed row of dots that gives away nothing about its length.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: Keyboard-first grid for real data: one tab stop, arrow keys between cells, a stable sort whose arrow flips its head, columns resized by pointer or keys, range selection, and thousands of rows virtualized without a dependency.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date picker
items.description: Date field that opens a calendar dialog with full grid keyboard support. Months slide a short way in the direction you moved, crossfading inside a soft-edged panel, and ranges are optional.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal that grows out of its trigger and eases to fit its content as steps change. It locks scroll without a shift and asks before discarding edits.

items.name: diff-view
items.title: Diff view
items.description: Unified diff with the changed part of each line marked and unchanged stretches folded. In streaming mode, new lines fade in as they arrive.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Modal panel that slides in from the end edge, and on phones rises as a sheet you drag down to dismiss, at the speed of your flick. The body scrolls between a header and footer that stay put.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: Menu button with checkbox, radio and submenu items. Submenus forgive a diagonal pointer path, and pointer and keyboard share one highlight.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: The message for an empty list or view: a clean isometric line drawing with crisp corners (a stack, a box, a folder, a tray, a magnifier, a calendar or an unplugged cord), drawn once as it comes into view, with a title, one sentence and one action.

items.name: file-upload
items.title: File upload
items.description: Drop zone with a fixed-height file list. Each row fills with its upload progress, and the list scrolls inside its height, so the page never moves.

items.name: inline-edit
items.title: Inline edit
items.description: Text that becomes an input where it stands, in the same font and the same place, so not a letter moves. Enter saves, Escape restores, and an error keeps you editing.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A key or a shortcut as the reader’s keyboard labels it: ⌘K on Apple, Ctrl K elsewhere. Decided before the first paint, so the server and the browser agree and nothing moves.

items.name: list
items.title: List
items.description: Rows of peers, static, links or buttons, each row one tab stop with nothing nested inside it. Secondary actions show on hover or focus without moving anything, and every row keeps its height in every state.

items.name: markdown
items.title: Markdown
items.description: Renders a model's markdown reply while it streams: no flash of raw asterisks, backticks or half-typed tables, code fences open as live code blocks, and HTML in the reply shows as text.

items.name: message-thread
items.title: Message thread
items.description: Chat transcript that fades in only the newly streamed words. It stays pinned to the bottom until you scroll up and announces each reply once it ends.

items.name: model-picker
items.title: Model picker
items.description: Compact trigger that resizes to fit the current model’s name. It opens a list of models with one-line descriptions and a drawn check on the selection.

items.name: nav-rail
items.title: Nav rail
items.description: A compact app rail of icon items. One tooltip glides from item to item, easing to each label’s width with the shortcut beside it, and a raised capsule glides to the current page.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number input
items.description: Spinbutton whose − and + buttons speed up while held. A typed value outside min or max is pulled into range, with a note that says so.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page numbers in a fixed number of slots, so the control never changes width as you page. Numbers slide under one moving pill, and Next stays focusable at the end.

items.name: phone-input
items.title: Phone input
items.description: Phone field with a country picker. The number groups as you type without moving the caret, a pasted +44 number picks its country, and the form gets E.164.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Click-triggered panel anchored to its trigger. It moves focus into forms, leaves it on the trigger for explanations, and returns it on close.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Linear progress whose fill moves on a spring. The indeterminate state sweeps a band of light through the track, and a segmented variant shows named steps.

items.name: prompt-input
items.title: Prompt input
items.description: Chat composer that grows with its text and sends on Enter, never mid-IME. Send turns into Stop while a reply streams, and dropped files become chips.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: Base UI radios in a fieldset, as a list or as cards. The mark opens from its center, arrow keys choose, and the whole group takes one tab stop.

items.name: response-actions
items.title: Response actions
items.description: The row under an assistant reply: copy, thumbs up and down, and retry. A thumbs down can open a “What went wrong?” field in place.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll area
items.description: Scroll container whose edges fade with a mask only where more content remains. It works on any background and scrolls by keyboard.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: Search input whose clear button fades in over room it already holds, so the text never moves. Escape clears, then leaves, and the magnifier breathes while results load.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: Base UI radio group with the Tabs' look: a clear hairline track and one flat pill that glides to the checked option. Arrow keys and form values come with the group.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Select-only combobox whose trigger fits the chosen label and morphs to the next one. Touch screens get the native picker instead.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: The app sidebar for an AI product: a workspace switcher, items with counts and shortcuts, folding sections, a recent chats list with rename, pin and delete, and an account menu. Collapses to an icon rail with one gliding tooltip, and becomes a drawer on phones.

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign in
items.description: A passwordless sign-in and sign-up screen: work email, then a one-time code with a resend countdown, plus optional OAuth providers and SSO by work domain. Wrong, expired and rate-limited codes, blocked domains and failed providers each say what to do next.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Placeholders shaped like the content on its way, with text lines exactly as tall as the text, so the swap moves nothing. One element per bone; one soft diagonal sheen crosses every skeleton on the page together, and nothing shows for loads under 300ms.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A label row with a steady-width value over a sunken track, an accent range and a raised capsule thumb that glides to place. Base UI's slider underneath handles pointer, keyboard and touch.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: A figure with its label and a change stated by both an arrow and words. The hint always takes two lines, so tiles in a row stay level.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Base UI switch with role="switch": the segmented control in miniature, a sunken track with a raised pill that glides across. Two sizes on the control scale and a busy state for saves.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Tabs built on Base UI, with a pill that stretches from one tab to the next. Optional URL sync supports back and forward, and panels crossfade in place.

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text field
items.description: Labeled input that validates when you leave it and clears the error as soon as the value is fixed. The error takes the hint’s line, so nothing shifts.

items.name: theme-toggle
items.title: Theme toggle
items.description: Icon capsule that switches light and dark: one drawing where the sun's disc grows into a crescent as a second circle slides over it. Stores the choice, follows the system until there is one, and paints the right theme before the first frame.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Imperative toasts in a collapsed stack that fans out on hover. Timers pause while you read, and a flick swipes a toast away.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Short hint that opens after a pause, then instantly as you move between triggers. Keyboard focus opens it at once.

items.name: usage-meter
items.title: Usage meter
items.description: How much of an agent’s context window or spending budget is used, as a ring and a percentage in the composer toolbar. Opens to a breakdown, warns before the limit and offers to compact.
